Abdollahi said on Sunday that any act of greed, bullying, expansionism, or brutality by the United States will face a decisive and destructive response, imposing costs “heavier than those of the second and third imposed wars.”
​
He described Iran’s defensive power as both a guarantee of nationwide security and a foundation enabling officials to work for the welfare of the Iranian people.
​
The general added that after repeated military failures, the enemy is now seeking to create division between the people and officials. Still, Iran’s internal unity is the key to defeating this “satanic scheme.”
​
He concluded that by God’s grace and with the guidance of the Leader, Iran will safeguard the unity that arises from the people’s historic mobilization.
